subject: Superseding R2 storage source implementation against current head
body:
FT-HERMES/1
CONTRACT: ACK-NACK-1
TYPE: TASK
TASK: R2-STORAGE-CONTRACT-CURRENT-R4
WIRE: CODEX-R2-STORAGE-CURRENT-R4-001
SEQ: 1
IN_REPLY_TO: HERMES-R2-STORAGE-ROUNDTRIP-COPY-R3-ACK-001
SUPERSEDES: CODEX-R2-STORAGE-ROUNDTRIP-COPY-R3-001
STATE: OPEN
TERMINAL: NO
NEXT_OWNER: HERMES
NEXT_ACTION: Verify SOURCE_REF exactly, materialize COPY_ROOT, return one correlated ACK/ACCEPTED or NACK/BLOCKED, then publish one evidence-bearing PROGRESS and one terminal DELIVERY or BLOCKED
REASON: CURRENT_HEAD_REFRESH_AFTER_M560
PAYLOAD_SHA256: NONE
PAYLOAD:
SOURCE_REPO: github.com/dominator509/axiom
SOURCE_BRANCH: refs/heads/codex/telegram-webhook-hardening
SOURCE_REF: a462ea0e74cec267ba61678909183ef4b652b51d
SOURCE_PRECHECK: The exact commit above is authoritative. Fetching the moving branch is allowed only as transport; never substitute its tip or an older release. If the exact commit cannot be verified, return terminal BLOCKED with the exact command and exit code.
COPY_ROOT: /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/codex-r2-storage-current-r4
COPY_ROOT_RULE: Work only in this isolated bridge-directory copy. Do not edit the source checkout or any prior delivery tree.
SCOPE: Close the source-level R2 media-storage gaps in the existing architecture. Audit the current Grok/R2 status/config routes, encrypted scoped credential contract, asset/media-upload/generated-asset/preview paths and media-gallery contract before editing. Reuse existing tenant/model/RLS/idempotency/access contracts; do not create a parallel gallery, storage model or unscoped provider path.
PASS_CRITERIA:
1. Implement real source behavior, not a baseline copy, plan, pure contract-only change or ACK-only response. Keep the user-visible status/configuration contract secret-free: never return credentials, bucket secrets, raw provider errors, signed URLs, internal paths or unbounded provider payloads.
2. Enforce bounded and normalized object identity for upload, generated output, preview and failed-upload reconciliation using the existing asset/media contracts. Reject absolute paths, traversal, schemes, cross-model keys, unsupported content types and over-limit payload metadata. Preserve source/generated/transformed lineage and uncertain-request idempotency.
3. Ensure configured-storage status, preview/view access, retention/deletion semantics and failure/retry states are explicit and fail closed. A stored descriptor is not proof of a successful external R2 write; unknown or unconfirmed outcomes must remain visible as unknown rather than success.
4. Wire the behavior to the existing authenticated API/dashboard surface only where the current architecture names one. Add or update reachable loading, empty, error, retry and success/unknown behavior tests. Do not invent a live R2 call or provider credential fixture in the source lane.
5. Add behavior tests for tenant/model isolation, secret/redaction boundaries, object-key/path validation, content type/size bounds, preview authorization, failed-upload/unknown reconciliation, idempotent retry and retention/deletion semantics supported by the existing contracts.
6. Run the owning focused tests, package typechecks and builds/lint for every changed package. Record exact commands and real exit codes.
7. DELIVERY must list the exact SOURCE_REF, COPY_ROOT, changed repository-relative paths, reproducible SHA-256 for every changed file, behavior-test names/counts, command exit codes, and LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE. Return terminal BLOCKED instead if the existing contracts cannot support a criterion without an unapproved schema/provider decision.
BOUNDARY: LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE. DO_NOT_TOUCH: installer, bridge service, deployment, live or disposable database, migrations or migration execution, provider calls, OAuth, credentials, permissions, systemd, network, runtime services, commit, push, generated build output, or files outside COPY_ROOT. Do not use dates, clocks or filesystem timestamps for coordination.
HANDOFF: Codex audits and integrates only a hash-verified terminal delivery, runs the owning checks, commits and pushes the reviewed milestone. ACK/REPLIED is transport only and is not implementation delivery. Every reply must end exactly with:
sincerely, Codex
